## Urgency

<!-- Is this time-sensitive? -->

- [ ] **Time-sensitive** — a hearing is scheduled within the next 7 days and this error could affect public understanding before the hearing
- [ ] **Standard** — no immediate deadline; standard 48h review is fine

---

## Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm:

- [ ] The source document is **publicly accessible** via the URL I have provided (no login, paywall, or download required)
- [ ] The source is **official or from a recognised, reputable publication**
- [ ] My correction does **not** contain bare allegations, personal opinions, or information from private or leaked documents
- [ ] I have quoted the source accurately and have not extrapolated beyond what the document states
